shots.purpose: Back in the golden garden, the untouched honeycomb and Keen watering flowers show a calmer, more responsible rhythm to the world; peace has been earned. / Fuzzby’s absurd flower disguise resurrects the opening honeycomb rivalry in a new form, proving the world’s comic logic is still happily intact. / The final sneeze payoff blows the disguise apart and lets Keen answer Fuzzby with the same playful language from before; the story closes on laughter and mutual recognition, not victory.

shots.kidRead: Keen is being good and watering the flowers now. / Fuzzby is pretending to be a flower! / The sneeze ruins the costume and Keen catches him.

shots.action: Golden sunset light. Keens honeycomb still sits untouched as he tends to the flowers watering his garden. Amongst the flowers FUZZBY is wearing a FLOWER DISGUISE — petals around his head like he’s trying to blend in. He smiles — pretending to be a flower. As Keens approaches a tiny puff of pollen floats through the air … landing right on Keen’s nose. Keen’s nose TWITCHES. He tries to hold it — shaking slightly— WIDE SHOT — Peaceful Garden. Honeycomb untouched. END.
